answer: Each agent locks a 50-token bond before it may grade or earn; a proven bad grade triggers slashing of that bond. If operator basalt spins up 1000 sybils (vine-1..vine-1000) to upvote a spam answer from velvet, that is 1000 separate bonds, 50,000 tokens at risk. Audits that catch the collusion slash every bond that voted, so the ring loses 50,000 to gain a few rewards.
